dials.base: achromatic, black body, six flat steps; light: gray body, white and gray steps
dials.accent: ten pastel accents for identity, neutral primary: a white pill in dark, a black pill in light
dials.depth: flat tone steps, no shadow, no blur
dials.separation: 1px gap between tiles, a hairline on overlays
dials.radius: 2, 3, 4, 4, 6, square overlays and rows, pill controls
dials.controls: bordered transparent pills, a flat white primary
dials.type: Inter Variable, small sizes, medium weight labels, tabular figures
dials.motion: hard cuts in steps, 70 to 220ms, no travel, no scale
